fact_types.title: Reportable gambling winnings in box 1 of one logical Form W-2G statement instance furnished by a payer for 2025. Nonnegative source amount only; the same payer, statement and tax-year identity as box 4 on the same statement, but a separate fact and a separate family. Not winnings without a Form W-2G, not gambling losses, not a professional gambler's business gambling.

Federal income tax withheld in box 4 of one logical Form W-2G statement instance furnished by a payer for 2025; same payer, statement and tax-year identity as box 1 on the same statement, but a separate fact and a separate family. Nonnegative source amount only. Not state or local withholding.
Affirmative closure of the Form W-2G box 1 winnings family at the current membership horizon.
Affirmative closure of the Form W-2G box 4 withholding family at the current membership horizon.

Schedule 1 / Form W-2G scope completeness component: apart from gambling winnings reported on a Form W-2G that is recorded, no Schedule 1 income on lines 8a-8z is present; in particular no gambling winnings that are not on a recorded Form W-2G, no Form W-2G in another person's name, and no gambling that is a trade or business. Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default, presence-before-value, free supersession. yes asserts the named excluded sources are absent; no asserts one is present and blocks the bounded additional-income claim.
